title: Outstanding experience
text: Our private tour went very smoothly from Seville hotel pickup to drop off. Our guide was very knowledgeable and provided much information about the area during our drive to the Caminito del Rey. The hike was spectacular providing beautiful vistas throughout. Our hike guide was also excellent. Our initial guide met us at the end of the hike and took us to an excellent restaurant with beautiful terrace views and excellent food for lunch. The ride back to our hotel was relaxing. Would highly recommend this private tour to the spectacular Caminito del Rey!
author: 906michelh

title: The caminito of the rey
text: We stayed on September 20, 2025. Tour organized from Malaga. Honestly you could also do it independently by taking a bus from the station Maria Zambrano Malaga .. however beautiful experience. The thrill of walking on the catwalks with hundreds of meters below. Beautiful views. Try it for those going to Malaga. Remember comfortable shoes. People wearing Sanit slippers or flip-flops are not accepted. We spent 50,00€ each round trip coach, guide and entrance ticket to the park. title: Beautiful
text: Beautiful landscape, accessible to everyone. We couldn’t find tickets without a guide and we had to wait quite a lot to start the walk. I would say it very touristic, dissapointing if you think it’s a hike…it’s not, it’s rather like a walk in the park but it’s worth a visit definitely!
